propositions: Live against throwaway ephemeral Jira DC projects must replace the flawed live-Cloud draft to faithfully model non-existent project keys that parse-error in real Jira (not return empty as fake transport did) and enable reproducible per-run scenarios without constraint of only two shared production projects
Inbound multi-project fetcher must fail closed when any configured project key does not exist in Jira, aborting the entire pass with no per-project try/except
Outbound mutations must be preview-gated to verify dry-run mutation set contains only targets in the intended project with empty intersection against every other configured project before sync runs

Four isolated scratch projects (one-repo, two-repo, zero-repo, legacy-default) provisioned from pinned template with verified capabilities must be created and destroyed per rehearsal run using session-scoped random RBJ-prefixed keys
Cross-project target errors must propagate through the library's exception wrapping (run_pass_result / rebar.RebarError) and be observable in both preview and sync fail-closed assertions
Inbound issues created in multiple scratch projects must be ingested in one pass with correct source project and repos recorded without contamination between projects
